TOP SIGNALING PATHWAYS BEYOND MHC-I MEDIATING KIR+CD8+ T CELL SUPPRESSION OF PATHOGENIC CD4+ T CELLS IN CELIAC DISEASE
==========================================================================================================================

Based on LIANA cell-cell communication analysis (rank_aggregate consensus, 1000 permutations) of 67,284 single cells from GSE193442 (6 CeD patients, 4 healthy controls), focusing on KIR+CD8+ T cells (n=1,571) -> CD4+ T cells (n=30,202):

1. CCL5 -> DPP4/CXCR3 (Chemokine CCL5-RANTES Signaling)
   - Most specific non-MHC interaction; highest magnitude (lr_means=1.956)
   - CeD-enriched 2x (specificity rank 0.0035 CeD vs 0.0072 HC)
   - CCL5 recruits and activates pathogenic CD4+ T cells via DPP4/CD26 and CXCR3

2. LGALS1 -> CD69/PTPRC/ITGB1 (Galectin-1 Immunosuppressive Pathway)
   - Three receptor interactions, all significant (p<0.001)
   - Strongest CeD-enrichment: LGALS1->CD69 specificity rank 0.0164 (CeD) vs 0.1069 (HC), ~6.5-fold enrichment
   - Galectin-1 is a potent immunosuppressive lectin that induces T cell apoptosis and cytokine suppression

3. CD47 -> SIRPG (SIRP-gamma Immune Checkpoint)
   - Specificity rank 0.0847; CeD-enriched 4.2x (0.0454 CeD vs 0.1925 HC)
   - Mediates T cell-T cell regulatory contact through the CD47-SIRP gamma axis

4. TGFB1 -> CXCR4/ITGB1 (TGF-beta Immunosuppressive Signaling)
   - Master immunosuppressive cytokine pathway; CeD-shared
   - Specificity rank 0.1118 for TGFB1->CXCR4; consistently active across conditions

5. FASLG -> FAS (Fas-FasL Cytotoxic Pathway)
   - CeD-SPECIFIC: significant in CeD but not detected in HC
   - Direct apoptotic killing mechanism; specificity rank 0.4907 in CeD

6. IFNG -> IFNGR1/IFNGR2 (IFN-gamma Signaling)
   - CeD-SPECIFIC: significant in CeD but not detected in HC
   - Effector cytokine signaling from KIR+CD8+ T cells to CD4+ T cells

7. IL16 -> CD4 (IL-16 Chemoattraction)
   - CD8-derived chemoattractant specific for CD4+ T cells
   - Specificity rank 0.0621; direct ligand-receptor engagement via the CD4 molecule itself

8. TNFSF12 -> TNFRSF25 (TNF Superfamily Signaling)
   - CeD-enriched 4.2x (specificity rank 0.1132 CeD vs 0.4762 HC)
   - Costimulatory and apoptotic signaling through the TNF receptor superfamily

9. ADAM10 -> IL6R (ADAM10-Mediated Receptor Shedding)
   - CeD-enriched 4.1x (specificity rank 0.0436 CeD vs 0.1793 HC)
   - Metalloprotease cleavage of IL6R modulates IL-6 signaling on target CD4+ T cells

10. SPON2 -> ITGA4/ITGA5/ITGB1/ITGB2 (Spondin-2 Integrin Adhesion)
    - Four integrin receptor interactions; CeD-shared
    - Physical contact/synapse formation enabling suppressive signaling and cytotoxic delivery

Additionally, MHC-II antigen presentation (HLA-DPB1/DPA1/DRB1/DQB1 -> CD4) ranked highest overall (specificity rank 0.0053), representing a non-MHC-I pathway where KIR+CD8+ T cells present antigens to CD4+ T cells through MHC class II molecules.

The CeD-specific pathways (FASLG->FAS, IFNG->IFNGR) and strongly CeD-enriched pathways (LGALS1, CD47->SIRPG, TNFSF12, ADAM10) together define the suppressive and cytotoxic toolkit that KIR+CD8+ T cells deploy against pathogenic gliadin-specific CD4+ T cells in celiac disease, beyond the established MHC-I/KIR inhibitory interaction.
